Description
Whether you are interested in investing in silver, engaging in silver collecting, or gaining a stunning piece of precious metal that has many functions, this 1 Kilo PAMP Suisse Silver Bar – Cast will not disappoint your expectations. The PAMP Suisse silver kilo bar is comprised of the Swiss minting corporation PAMP SA (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux). For more than 30 years, this renowned corporation has produced minted and cast products with simplistic elegance and expert craftsmanship – each item is the result of continued innovation and quality control that is exercised by every member of their workforce.
The 1 Kilogram PAMP Suisse Cast Silver Bars are widely recognized as one of the most appealing bullion options available on account of their heavy.999 fine silver content and beautiful sunken inscriptions which were not produced by stamping machines but created using solid blocks of silver (as opposed to flat sheets) after casting.
Before being produced, the bars go through an intense production process that includes:
1. Melting down .999 fine silver shot from non-recycled sources
2. Shaping these ingots into rectangular bars
3. Stamping these bars with the PAMP SA logo
*** Please note these bars do not come with an Assay certificate as they have been misplaced, They have however come from reputable sources and have been tested for purity.***
This PAMP Suisse silver kilo bar’s main attribute is its appearance and high standards: it has unique markings and a matte finish that makes each bar eye-catching and highly recognizable. Because each PAMP silver kilo bar was produced by casting, it appears slightly different from other silver bars on the market. PAMP kilo silver bar cast carries a higher premium than other bars of similar weight, but they are priced commensurate with their high quality.
Each 1 oz PAMP Suisse Silver Bar consists of one kilogram, or 32.15 troy ounces of .999 fine silver cast ingot, a hallmark that will not tarnish or corrode over time. The artistic cast pattern makes the Suisse 1 kilo fine silver.9999 unique from each other, adding to their collectible value.
Design of  1 Kilo PAMP Suisse Silver Bar
The PAMP Suisse 1 Kilo Silver Bars feature the PAMP Suisse logo, weight, and fineness level on the obverse side. Each of the Suisse silver kilo bar comes with a unique 6-digit serial number inscribed on the front. The pamp silver kilo bars are also stamped with the phrase “Essayeur Fonder” alongside a PAMP logo bounded by a rectangle. The stamp guarantees that the PAMP kilo silver bar used to mint is assayed and certified as authentic and of the best quality.
The 1 Kilo Silver Bar-PAMP Suisse reverse
features the bar’s frosted finish, with no markings of any kind.
